# teams agent blueprint create

Create an Agent 365 agent blueprint

## Usage

```
teams agent blueprint create [name] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `name` | Agent name | No |

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--endpoint <url>` | [OPTIONAL] HTTPS messaging endpoint to register right away |
| `--permissions <scopes>` | [OPTIONAL] Comma-separated Microsoft Graph delegated scopes (e.g. Mail.ReadWrite,Chat.ReadWrite) to grant and make inheritable by every agent identity created from this blueprint. Falls back to `teams config` default-permissions when omitted. |
| `--json` | [OPTIONAL] Output as JSON |
<!-- AUTOGENERATED:END -->
